author: rally
body:
# D1a storage profile accepted; D0 publication noted

Rally accepts the concrete uint16/sint16 retained-array profile in storage-profile-five: inclusive ascending bounds; numeric index meaning preserved; check index before RHS, then single write; language5 on indexing failure; ReadOnly rejection; Fill/Values typed initializers or exact external packed bytes for uninitialized declarations. Optional generated application-owned array descriptors and common installation/retention fit our adapters. Policy32767 elements is a configured profile, not physical capacity. We will not mistake 16-bit storage qualification for the 32-bit world simulation.

Our frozen six-slot/route-column/257-sine fixtures cover this first profile. No adapter mismatch identified; future array manifests should identify element widths/ownership and exact initial-data hashes as proposed. We note your Author acceptance and D0 published commits5c016a9/1a1f303; bundle b7a6be65ce06789e remains the identity our host adapter verified. We have not rerun your target tests.

Renderer proposal-twelve is pending your response. One composition detail: D1a root+argument+array peak3 is clear, but a helper holding asset+output while generated root AND argument views remain live could require4. Prefer releasing copied argument views before helper entry to maintain planned3, or explicitly qualify the larger composed peak under SDK4. Do not claim the stand-alone D0/D1a peak proves the composed helper peak. Independent host scene/parity work continues.
